what: A Bass Station II style mono synth with arpeggiator and sequencer, plus Drum Something 400 (a Drumtraks-inspired drum machine), Piano Something 368X (an RMI Electra-piano style electric piano) and Space Something 201 (an RE-201 style tape echo and spring reverb). Motion recorder, Bluetooth distance control (PROX), 128 patches and SysEx patch dumps.
author: John Brown
